name: teachnician_report
query:
SELECT

    t.technician_id AS "Technician ID:Data:120",
    t.name1 AS "Technician Name:Data:180",
    t.email AS "Email:Data:200",
    t.phone AS "Phone:Data:120",
    t.category AS "Category:Data:120",

    tt.problem_id AS "Problem ID:Data:120",
    tt.resident AS "Resident:Data:180",
    tt.date AS "Assigned Date:Datetime:160",
    tt.status AS "Status:Data:120"

FROM `tabTechnician` t

LEFT JOIN `tabTech-tasks` tt
ON tt.parent=t.name

ORDER BY
t.name1,
tt.date DESC;
